name: hud_ui_zrd_widget_on_activate
description: HudUiZrdWidget::OnActivate resets transition input, applies the activate image, clears rollover labels, and toggles activate/default labels.
known_limits: Local VC COFF byte target hud_ui_zrd_widget_on_activate now covers 0x4b5900 but fails under vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs and vc5_o2_ob1_md_gx_facs with 195 unmasked byte mismatches after 28 relocation-masked bytes and 2 trimmed VC NOPs, BN size 240 vs VC5 size 144.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4b5900 validates ResetAllTransitionState, optional activate-image install, rollover play-handle stop, optional activate sound playback, rollover label hiding, activate-label showing, and default-label visibility fallback.
The native zHud widget helper smoke exercises the activate-image path and verifies default, rollover, and activate label visibility after OnActivate.
